SunsetSpots.title: Sunset Spots in São Vicente
SunsetSpots.description: The best places around the island to watch the sun go down over the Atlantic.

card.opensInNewTab: opens in Google Maps in a new tab

descriptions.laginha-beach: A wide sandy beach with a calm bay, perfect for a relaxed walk as the sky turns orange.
descriptions.baia-das-gatas: A quiet bay on the coast, ideal for watching the sunset with the sound of the waves.
descriptions.fortim-del-rei: A historic fort above Mindelo with open views over the bay and the harbour.
descriptions.monte-verde: The island's highest point, with sweeping views of São Vicente and the neighbouring islands.
